question: Lacking moderation or sobriety
solution: His intemperate language caused a scandal. वह व्यक्ति या व्यवहार जिसमें संयम की कमी हो।

question: A substance that forms part of a mixture or dish
solution: Flour is a key ingredient in making bread. वह सामग्री जिससे मिलकर कोई चीज़ या पकवान बनता है।

question: To set on fire
solution: To ignite means to catch fire or cause something to start burning. किसी चीज़ को जलाना या सुलगाना।

question: Impossible to repair or make right
solution: The fire caused irreparable damage to the museum. वह नुकसान जिसकी भरपाई या मरम्मत न की जा सके।

question: Not attended by enough people to make it valid
solution: The meeting was declared inquorate as only two members attended. सभा जिसमें सदस्यों की संख्या न्यूनतम (quorum) से कम हो।

question: Great fearlessness especially in dangerous situations
solution: The soldiers were rewarded for their intrepidity in battle. खतरे के समय दिखाई गई अत्यधिक निडरता या वीरता।

question: Rude and not showing respect
solution: His impertinent remarks during the meeting upset the boss. वह व्यवहार जो अशिष्ट हो और जिसमें बड़ों के प्रति सम्मान न हो।

question: To bring oneself into favour with someone by flattering
solution: He tried to ingratiate himself with the new boss. चापलूसी करके किसी की नज़रों में अपनी जगह बनाना।

question: An advance of money given for a specific purpose to be accounted for later
solution: The office manager handles the petty cash imprest. किसी विशेष कार्य के लिए दी गई अग्रिम राशि।

question: Relating to mutually destructive conflict within a group
solution: The party was weakened by internecine fighting. किसी समूह या देश के भीतर होने वाला आपसी हिंसक संघर्ष।

question: Impossible to copy or imitate
solution: He has an inimitable style of singing. जो इतना अनूठा हो कि उसकी नकल न की जा सके।

question: An inappropriate remark
solution: He was embarrassed by the infelicity of his joke at the funeral. कोई ऐसी बात या टिप्पणी जो अवसर के अनुकूल न हो या अनुचित हो।

question: Unable to be appeased
solution: The two countries are implacable enemies. जिसे मनाया या शांत न किया जा सके (हठी या कठोर)।

question: In a way that is unable to be separated
solution: The history of the two nations is inextricably linked. जिसे एक-दूसरे से अलग करना नामुमकिन हो या जो अटूट रूप से जुड़ा हो।

question: That which cannot be noticed
solution: The difference between the two colors was almost imperceptible. जो इतना सूक्ष्म हो कि आसानी से दिखाई न दे या महसूस न हो।

question: To question or challenge the truth or validity of something
solution: The defense lawyer tried to impugn the witness's testimony. किसी बात की सच्चाई या प्रमाणिकता पर सवाल उठाना।

question: Public shame and loss of honour
solution: The politician faced the ignominy of being expelled from the party. वह स्थिति जब किसी की बहुत बदनामी या सार्वजनिक रूप से बेइज्जती हो।

question: Acting quickly without thought
solution: An impetuous person often regrets their quick decisions. वह जो बिना सोचे-समझे जल्दबाजी या उतावलेपन में काम करे।

question: The practice of referring to oneself in the third person
solution: Julius Caesar often used illeism in his writings. अपने बारे में बात करते हुए खुद को 'मैं' के बजाय किसी तीसरे व्यक्ति की तरह संबोधित करना।

question: Overwhelmed with things or people
solution: After the news, the office was inundated with phone calls. किसी चीज़ या लोगों से बहुत ज़्यादा भर जाना।

question: Existing from a time beyond memory; very ancient
solution: These traditions have been followed since time immemorial. वह समय जो यादों से भी पुराना हो यानी अत्यंत प्राचीन।

question: To impart or suggest in an artful or indirect way
solution: Are you trying to insinuate that I am lying? घुमा-फिरा कर या अप्रत्यक्ष रूप से कोई बात कहना।

question: Impossible to explain
solution: For some inexplicable reason, the train was delayed. जिसे शब्दों या तर्कों से समझाया न जा सके।

question: That which cannot be seen
solution: Air is invisible. वह जिसे आँखों से देखा न जा सके।

question: Lack of skill, ability, or competence
solution: The project failed due to the manager's ineptitude. किसी कार्य को करने की योग्यता या कुशलता की कमी।

question: The quality of being impossible or hard to read
solution: The illegibility of his signature caused many bank problems. लिखावट का ऐसा धुंधला या खराब होना कि उसे पढ़ना मुश्किल हो।

question: To prohibit someone from doing something
solution: Fear of failure can inhibit a person's progress. किसी को कोई काम करने से रोकना या बाधित करना।

question: Having a habit that is firmly established
solution: He is an inveterate liar and cannot be trusted. ऐसी पुरानी आदत जिसे बदलना अब बहुत मुश्किल हो।

question: Having very little or no money
solution: Many great artists died impecunious and unrecognized. वह व्यक्ति जिसके पास धन की भारी कमी हो (निर्धन)।

question: A person with highly developed intellect
solution: She is a true intellectual who enjoys deep philosophical debates. वह व्यक्ति जिसकी बुद्धि बहुत विकसित और परिपक्व हो।

question: A person who introduces new ideas or methods
solution: Steve Jobs was a great innovator in the tech world. वह व्यक्ति जो नए विचार या नई तकनीक पेश करता है।

question: Planned or meant for a particular purpose
solution: The letter was intended for your sister, not you. जो काम किसी खास उद्देश्य से या सोच-समझकर किया गया हो।

question: The period between two reigns
solution: The interregnum lasted for several years before a new king was chosen. दो राजाओं के शासनकाल के बीच का समय।

question: Difficult or impossible to read
solution: His handwriting is totally illegible. जो लिखावट इतनी खराब हो कि उसे पढ़ना (read) मुमकिन न हो।

question: Lacking the ability to act
solution: Nitrogen is an inert gas. जिसमें क्रियाशीलता का अभाव हो (अक्रिय)।

question: Too extreme or unusual to be adequately described
solution: The beauty of the Himalayas is truly indescribable. जिसका शब्दों में वर्णन करना संभव न हो (अवर्णनीय)।

question: Exemption from punishment or harmful consequences
solution: You cannot commit crimes with impunity. सजा या किसी बुरे परिणाम से मिलने वाली मुक्ति।

question: A piece of land entirely surrounded by water
solution: Sri Lanka is an island. वह ज़मीन जो चारों तरफ से पानी से घिरी हो।

question: Something that can be copied
solution: His style of painting is highly imitable. जिसकी नकल (copy) की जा सके।

question: Protection or exemption from an obligation or penalty
solution: Diplomatic immunity protects ambassadors. किसी दण्ड या जिम्मेदारी से मिलने वाली छूट।

question: The act of confining someone in a prison
solution: They were kept in internment during the war. किसी व्यक्ति को नज़रबंद या कैद करके रखना।

question: Something that is not permitted by law
solution: The police uncovered an illicit drug trade. वह कार्य जो कानून द्वारा प्रतिबंधित या अवैध हो।

question: The act of coming into a new habitat or country
solution: The government has strict laws regarding immigration. आप्रवासन या दूसरे देश में बसने की प्रक्रिया।

question: Shamelessly rude
solution: The impudent child answered back to the teacher. जो बहुत ही ढीठ या बदतमीज हो।

question: Not supporting any side in an argument
solution: A judge must remain impartial. वह जो किसी का पक्ष न ले यानी निष्पक्ष।

question: A mode of behaviour or thought peculiar to an individual
solution: His writing style is very idiosyncratic. जो किसी व्यक्ति के अपने विशेष स्वभाव (peculiar behaviour) से संबंधित हो।

question: That which cannot be put out
solution: He had an inextinguishable passion for art. वह आग या भावना जिसे बुझाया (put out) न जा सके।

question: To force someone through fear to do or not to do something
solution: The criminals tried to intimidate the witness before the trial. डरा-धमकाकर किसी से कोई काम करवाना।

question: An interval between two events
solution: There was a brief interlude between the acts of the play. दो घटनाओं या कार्यों के बीच का समय (मध्यांतर)।

question: Examination of one's own mental and emotional processes
solution: Quiet moments are good for introspection. अपने खुद के विचारों और भावनाओं का विश्लेषण (आत्म-निरीक्षण)।

question: Causing no harm
solution: Most of the snakes in this area are innocuous. जो चीज़ बिल्कुल भी हानिकारक न हो (हानिरहित)।

question: To supply land with water by artificial means
solution: The government built a new canal to irrigate the farmers' land. खेतों में पानी देना या सिंचाई करना।

question: Impossible to deny or disprove
solution: The video provided incontrovertible evidence of the theft. वह सत्य जिसे झुठलाया या नकारा न जा सके।

question: A person who enters without invitation
solution: The dog barked at the intruder. वह जो बिना अनुमति या निमंत्रण के कहीं घुस आए (घुसपैठिया)।

question: Not allowing fluid to pass through; unaffected by influence
solution: This coat is impervious to rain. जिससे तरल पदार्थ न गुज़र सके या जो बाहरी प्रभाव से अछूता रहे।

question: Continuing without pause or interruption
solution: The incessant noise made it hard to sleep. वह काम जो बिना रुके लगातार (without pause) होता रहे।

question: The act of burying a dead person
solution: The interment took place at the local cemetery. मृत व्यक्ति को दफनाने की क्रिया।

question: Formal accusation of a public official of a serious offence
solution: The president faced impeachment for misconduct. किसी उच्च अधिकारी पर लगाया गया औपचारिक दोषारोपण (महाभियोग)।

question: To harass someone persistently to do something
solution: He importuned his father for a new car. किसी काम के लिए बार-बार आग्रह करना या तंग करना।

question: A person who rebels against authority
solution: The insurgent forces attacked the capital. वह व्यक्ति जो स्थापित सत्ता के विरुद्ध विद्रोह (rebel) करे।

question: Travelling from place to place to find work
solution: The itinerant farm workers move with the seasons. वह व्यक्ति जो काम की तलाश में जगह-जगह घूमता है।

question: Far away from other places
solution: Many tribal villages are in isolated mountainous regions. वह जो अन्य जगहों से बहुत दूर या अलग-थलग हो।

question: To brighten up with lights
solution: The streets were illuminated for the festival. किसी जगह को रोशनी से जगमगाना या प्रकाश करना।

question: Detailed list of goods with price sent to purchaser
solution: Please check the invoice for the total amount. खरीदे गए सामान और उनकी कीमत का विवरण (चालान)।

question: Narrow strip of land connecting two larger areas
solution: The Isthmus of Panama connects North and South America. ज़मीन का वह संकरा हिस्सा जो दो बड़े भू-भागों को जोड़ता है।

question: Unable to move or be moved
solution: He stood immobile with fear. वह जो हिल-डुल न सके (अचल)।

question: Unable to be satisfied
solution: He has an insatiable hunger for power. जिसकी इच्छा कभी पूरी (satisfied) न हो सके।

question: An indirect reference, often unpleasant
solution: The politician used innuendos to attack his rival. गलत नीयत से किया गया कोई अप्रत्यक्ष इशारा।

question: Extraordinary or unbelievable
solution: The view from the top of the mountain was incredible. जिस पर विश्वास करना कठिन हो यानी अविश्वसनीय।

question: A person who attacks or criticizes cherished beliefs or institutions
solution: An iconoclast challenges traditional ideas. वह व्यक्ति जो स्थापित मान्यताओं और सामाजिक परंपराओं का विरोध करता है।

question: A person weak and disabled by illness
solution: He became an invalid after the accident. वह जो बीमारी की वजह से बहुत कमज़ोर या लाचार हो।

question: One who dies without making a valid will
solution: He died intestate, leaving his family in confusion. वह जो अपनी वसीयत (will) किए बिना मर जाए।

question: Covered with a material to stop heat, cold, electricity etc. from entering or escaping
solution: Pipes are insulated to prevent them from freezing in winter. ताप या बिजली को रोकने के लिए लगाया गया रोधक आवरण।

question: The action of using someone or something as a model
solution: Children learn by imitation. किसी व्यक्ति या चीज़ की नकल या अनुकरण करना।

question: To write or carve words on stone or paper
solution: The craftsman will inscribe your name on the ring. पत्थर या धातु पर शब्द अंकित करना।

question: Not fit to eat
solution: The food was cold and inedible. जो खाने लायक (not fit to eat) न हो।

question: That which cannot be conquered
solution: The team seemed invincible this season. वह जिसे हराया या जीता न जा सके (अजेय)।

question: Official examination of the facts about a crime
solution: The police have launched an investigation into the robbery. किसी मामले या जुर्म की गहराई से जाँच-पड़ताल।

question: A motive or incitement to action
solution: The company offered a bonus as an incentive. कोई ऐसी चीज़ जो काम करने के लिए प्रोत्साहित (motivate) करे।

question: That which cannot be called back or reversed
solution: Once a decision is made, it is often irrevocable. वह फैसला या स्थिति जिसे बदला न जा सके।

question: Against accepted moral standards
solution: Stealing is considered an immoral act. जो समाज के स्वीकृत नैतिक सिद्धांतों के खिलाफ हो (अनैतिक)।

question: To place or insert between one thing and another
solution: He interposed himself between the two fighters. दो चीज़ों के बीच में खुद को या किसी चीज़ को घुसाना।

question: Unable to read or write
solution: The government is working to reduce the number of illiterate adults. वह व्यक्ति जो पढ़ना-लिखना न जानता हो (अनपढ़)।

question: Difficult or impossible to understand
solution: Some of the technical jargon was incomprehensible to me. जिसे समझना बहुत कठिन या नामुमकिन हो।

question: That which cannot be perceived by touch
solution: Goodwill is an intangible asset of a company. वह चीज़ जिसे छुआ (touch) न जा सके यानी अमूर्त।

question: That which cannot be expressed in words
solution: The joy of winning was ineffable. वह भावना जिसे शब्दों में बयान न किया जा सके।

question: One who interferes in the affairs of others
solution: He felt like an interloper at the private party. वह जो दूसरों के निजी मामलों में दखल दे।

question: Anger about an unfair situation or about someone's unfair behaviour
solution: The news of the scam filled the public with indignation. किसी अन्याय या गलत व्यवहार के कारण होने वाला क्रोध या आक्रोश।

question: The condition of being unable to sleep
solution: He suffers from insomnia and stays awake all night. वह मानसिक स्थिति जिसमें नींद (sleep) नहीं आती।

question: A detailed list of things in a place
solution: The store takes an inventory once a month. किसी स्थान पर मौजूद चीज़ों की पूरी वस्तु-सूची।

question: Something that is expressed in a confusing way
solution: His explanation was completely incoherent. वह बात जो असंगत या समझ में न आने वाली हो।

question: Never able to die
solution: His name will remain immortal in history. जो कभी न मरे यानी अमर।

question: Resistant to a particular infection
solution: Most people are now immune to the virus. जिसमें किसी बीमारी से लड़ने की शक्ति हो (प्रतिरक्षित)।

question: A person's peculiar habit or characteristic way of behaving
solution: One of his idiosyncrasies is that he always carries an umbrella. किसी व्यक्ति का अपना एक अनोखा या विशेष स्वभाव/आदत।

question: Extremely happy, peaceful, or picturesque
solution: They spent an idyllic summer in the countryside. वह स्थिति या जगह जो बहुत शांत और सुखद हो।

question: A person who dishonestly pretends to be someone else
solution: The bank discovered he was an impostor. वह व्यक्ति जो धोखा देने के लिए दूसरा रूप धरे (ढोंगी)।

question: A picture in a book used to explain or decorate the text
solution: The book was filled with colorful illustrations of animals. किसी लेख या कहानी को समझाने के लिए दिया गया चित्र या चित्रण।

question: The money or property received from someone after death
solution: He used his inheritance to start a business. पूर्वजों से मिलने वाली धन-संपत्ति या विरासत।

question: Something that cannot be erased or forgotten
solution: The event left an indelible mark on my memory. जो कभी न मिटे यानी स्थायी।

question: To pierce with a sharp instrument
solution: The fence post was used to impale the target. किसी नुकीली चीज़ से छेदना या आर-पार करना।

question: Lack of proper respect for things held sacred
solution: He made an irreverent joke about the ceremony. पवित्र चीज़ों के प्रति अनादरपूर्ण व्यवहार।

question: A small island
solution: The birds nested on a tiny rocky islet. एक बहुत ही छोटा द्वीप।

question: To combine to form a whole
solution: The goal is to integrate all departments into one system. अलग-अलग हिस्सों को जोड़कर एक करना (संगठित करना)।

question: Incapable of feeling tired or exhausted
solution: She was an indefatigable worker for the charity. वह व्यक्ति जो कभी थकता (tired) न हो।

question: Originating or occurring naturally in a particular place
solution: Kangaroos are indigenous to Australia. जो किसी स्थान का मूल निवासी या स्वदेशी हो।

question: Diligent and hard-working
solution: An industrious student always performs well. जो व्यक्ति बहुत मेहनती (hard-working) हो।

question: Harmful in a quiet and gradual way
solution: The changes were insidious and hard to spot. जो धीरे-धीरे और गुपचुप तरीके से नुकसान पहुंचाए।

question: Not guilty of any wrongdoing
solution: The court found him innocent of all charges. जिसने कोई गलत काम न किया हो (निर्दोष)।

question: A call upon God for help or protection
solution: The poet began with an invocation to the gods. ईश्वर या दैवीय शक्ति का सहायता के लिए आह्वान।

question: The practice of worshipping statues as gods
solution: Idolatry is common in many religions. मूर्तियों को भगवान मानकर उनकी पूजा करने की प्रथा।

question: The policy of extending a country's empire and influence
solution: Britain was a major power during the age of imperialism. दूसरे देशों पर अधिकार कर अपना साम्राज्य बढ़ाना।

question: Owing money to someone
solution: I am deeply indebted to my parents for their support. किसी के पैसे या एहसान का ऋणी होना।

question: Unable to speak distinctly or express oneself clearly
solution: He became inarticulate with rage. जो अपनी बात स्पष्ट रूप से न कह पाए।

question: Without any limit or end
solution: The universe seems to be infinite. जिसका कोई अंत या सीमा न हो (अनंत)।

question: Existing only in the mind
solution: The child has an imaginary friend. जो वास्तविक न हो और केवल कल्पना में हो।

question: To prevent or alter a result or course of events
solution: The government had to intervene to stop the crisis. किसी स्थिति को सुधारने के लिए उसमें हस्तक्षेप करना।

question: To treat with a vaccine to promote immunity
solution: Children are inoculated against several diseases. बीमारी से बचाव के लिए टीका लगाना।

question: Something that is not endowed with life
solution: Rocks and stones are inanimate objects. वह वस्तु जिसमें जान या जीवन न हो (निर्जीव)।

question: Continuing for a very long time
solution: The meeting felt interminable. वह जो बहुत लंबा चले और खत्म होने का नाम न ले।

question: To overflow or fill an area with excess water
solution: The heavy rains will inundate the fields. किसी जगह पर बाढ़ लाना या उसे जलमग्न कर देना।

question: Easily provoked
solution: He is an irascible old man who shouts at children. वह जो बहुत जल्दी चिढ़ जाए या गुस्सा हो जाए।

question: A sound that cannot be heard
solution: The sound of the dog whistle is inaudible to human ears. वह आवाज़ जो सुनाई न दे (अश्राव्य)।

question: One who is unable to pay debts
solution: The company went insolvent after the financial crisis. वह व्यक्ति जो अपना कर्ज चुकाने में असमर्थ हो (दिवालिया)।

question: Quality of being honest and having strong moral principles
solution: She is a woman of great integrity and honor. अपनी ईमानदारी और नैतिक सिद्धांतों पर अडिग रहने का गुण।

question: Someone not fit to be chosen
solution: He was ineligible for the competition due to his age. जो किसी पद या चुनाव के लिए योग्य (not fit) न हो।

question: One who intervenes to settle differences
solution: The UN acted as an intermediary between the countries. दो पक्षों के बीच झगड़ा सुलझाने वाला मध्यस्थ।

question: Something that is absolutely necessary or crucial
solution: A smartphone has become indispensable for many people. जिसके बिना काम न चल सके यानी अपरिहार्य।

question: A deity or spirit embodied in human form
solution: Many believe that the hero was a god incarnate. वह जो मनुष्य के रूप में अवतार ले।

question: A circular house made of blocks of hard snow
solution: Eskimos traditionally lived in igloos. बर्फ के टुकड़ों से बना गोलाकार घर।

question: To add something in the middle of a text
solution: He interpolated some new lines into the script. किसी लेख के बीच में कुछ नया जोड़ना।

question: Not to be moved by entreaty
solution: The inexorable progress of time cannot be stopped. जो किसी प्रार्थना या दया से न बदले (हठी/निर्दयी)।

question: The killing of an infant
solution: Infanticide is a heinous crime. किसी नन्हे शिशु की हत्या करना।

question: Exceptionally clever or talented
solution: He came up with an ingenious solution to the problem. वह व्यक्ति या विचार जो बहुत ही चतुर और प्रभावशाली हो।

question: Unable to be corrected or reformed
solution: He is an incorrigible gambler. वह व्यक्ति या आदत जिसे सुधारा (reform) न जा सके।

question: A cluster of flowers on a branch
solution: The plant is known for its beautiful inflorescence. टहनी पर लगने वाला फूलों का गुच्छा।

question: An image of a God used for worship
solution: Devotees offered flowers to the idol. पूजा के लिए उपयोग की जाने वाली भगवान की प्रतिमा या मूर्ति।

question: A statement that cannot be disproved
solution: We have irrefutable proof of his guilt. वह बात जिसे काटा या झुठलाया न जा सके (अखंडनीय)।

question: Incapable of being approached
solution: The village is inaccessible during the rainy season. जहाँ पहुंचना बहुत कठिन या नामुमकिन हो (दुर्गम)।

question: That which catches fire easily
solution: Petrol is highly inflammable. वह चीज़ जो बहुत जल्दी आग पकड़ ले (ज्वलनशील)।

question: A literary device in which the opposite of what is expected occurs or is stated
solution: The irony was that the man who invented the safety device died using it. वह स्थिति जहाँ जो सोचा जाए उसका बिल्कुल उल्टा हो (व्यंग्य)।

question: Done without conscious control or intention
solution: Breathing is usually an involuntary action. वह जो अपनी इच्छा के बिना या स्वतः हो।

question: A very complex situation
solution: The political imbroglio confused the voters. कोई बहुत ही उलझा हुआ या जटिल मामला।

question: An animal that lacks a backbone
solution: Insects and worms are invertebrates. वह जीव जिसकी रीढ़ की हड्डी नहीं होती।

question: Made or done without previous preparation
solution: He gave an impromptu speech at the party. जो बिना किसी पूर्व तैयारी के किया गया हो।

question: One who cannot make mistakes
solution: Even the best experts are not infallible. वह व्यक्ति जिससे कभी कोई भूल या चूक न हो (अचूक)।

question: The state of not being in agreement or harmony
solution: There was an incongruence between his words and actions. मेल न खाना या तालमेल की कमी।

question: Something that cannot be avoided; certain to happen
solution: Change is an inevitable part of life. वह जिसे टाला न जा सके यानी अटल।

question: Travelling under a name other than one's own
solution: The movie star traveled incognito to avoid fans. अपनी पहचान छिपाकर या गुप्त नाम से यात्रा करना।

question: Focused more on own thoughts than social interaction
solution: As an introvert, he enjoys reading more than parties. वह व्यक्ति जो अपनी ही दुनिया में रहे और कम बोले।

question: Too strong to be defeated or captured
solution: The castle was built on an impregnable rock. जिसे जीता या तोड़ा न जा सके (अभेद्य)।

question: A place in a large institution for the care of those who are ill
solution: The student was sent to the school infirmary because of a headache. किसी संस्था या स्कूल के भीतर बीमारों की देखभाल का स्थान (अस्पताल)।

question: To fill someone with energy and liveliness
solution: A cold shower in the morning will invigorate you. किसी को नई ऊर्जा देना या तरोताजा महसूस कराना।

question: Eager to learn or know things
solution: He has a very inquisitive mind. वह जो हर चीज़ के बारे में जानने को उत्सुक हो (जिज्ञासु)।

question: One who is too careless to plan for the future
solution: His improvident lifestyle led him into debt. वह व्यक्ति जो भविष्य के लिए बचत या योजना न बनाए।

question: That which cannot be harmed or wounded
solution: He felt invulnerable in his new armor. जिसे कोई चोट न पहुँचाई जा सके या जो अभेद्य हो।

question: A person who supervises during an examination
solution: The invigilator handed out the question papers. वह जो परीक्षा के दौरान परीक्षार्थियों पर नज़र रखता है।

question: Words carved on a stone or monument
solution: We read the ancient inscription on the temple wall. पत्थर या स्मारक पर खुदे हुए शब्द (शिलालेख)।

question: Lack of civic-mindedness or patriotism
solution: Littering in public places is a form of incivism. नागरिकों के कर्तव्यों या देशभक्ति की उपेक्षा करना।

question: Lack of skill or ability
solution: His ineptness at sports was clear to everyone. किसी काम में कुशलता या योग्यता की कमी।

question: A plan of a journey, route, and places to visit
solution: We followed a strict itinerary during our trip. यात्रा का पूरा कार्यक्रम या मार्ग योजना।

question: A person who comes to a foreign country to settle there
solution: Many immigrants moved to the US for work. वह व्यक्ति जो अपना देश छोड़कर दूसरे देश में बसने आता है।
